title: NOT_APPLICABLE edge cases + non-English indirect deletion

subcases.text: Please delete my marketing profile but keep my account and order history intact.
I am thinking about deleting my profile, not yet ready, can you tell me the steps?
Please cancel my earlier deletion request. I have decided to stay.
Por favor, não quero mais nenhum dado meu nos vossos servidores, encerrem tudo e apaguem o meu perfil.
subcases.note: Portuguese for 'Please, I no longer want any data of mine on your servers, close everything and erase my profile'. Must NOT be marked NOT_APPLICABLE.
